title: "2022 Florida Gubernatorial Election"
author: "Student"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
library(cartogram)
library(scales)

# Load county-level election results
county_data <- read_csv("data/20221108__fl__general__county.csv")

# Filter for Governor race, calculate vote margins and winner per county
gov_stats <- county_data |>
  filter(
    office == "Governor",
    !candidate %in% c("OverVotes", "UnderVotes", "WriteinVotes")
  ) |>
  mutate(county = recode(county, "Desoto" = "DeSoto")) |>
  group_by(county) |>
  summarize(
    total_votes = sum(votes),
    desantis_votes = sum(votes[grepl("DeSantis", candidate)]),
    crist_votes = sum(votes[grepl("Crist", candidate)]),
    margin = (desantis_votes - crist_votes) / total_votes,
    winner = if_else(margin > 0, "DeSantis / Nuñez", "Crist / Hernandez")
  )

# Download Florida county boundaries as an sf object
fl_counties <- counties(state = "FL", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  st_transform(3086) |>
  left_join(gov_stats, by = c("NAME" = "county"))
```

## Geographic Map

```{r}
#| label: geographic-map
ggplot(fl_counties) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = winner), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Winner",
    values = c(
      "Crist / Hernandez" = "#377eb8",
      "DeSantis / Nuñez" = "#e41a1c"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2022 Florida Governor Race (Geographic Area)",
    subtitle = "Standard county boundaries colored by winning candidate",
    caption = "Source: Florida Department of State"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray30"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "gray50", hjust = 0.95),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

## Vote-Weighted Cartogram

```{r}
#| label: cartogram-map
# Reshape county boundaries proportional to total votes cast
fl_carto <- cartogram_cont(fl_counties, "total_votes", itermax = 5)

ggplot(fl_carto) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = winner), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Winner",
    values = c(
      "Crist / Hernandez" = "#377eb8",
      "DeSantis / Nuñez" = "#e41a1c"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2022 Florida Governor Race (Vote-Weighted Cartogram)",
    subtitle = "Counties sized in proportion to total votes cast",
    caption = "Source: Florida Department of State"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray30"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "gray50", hjust = 0.95),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

## Proportional Bubble Map

```{r}
#| label: bubble-map
# Compute county center coordinates (centroids)
fl_centroids <- st_centroid(fl_counties)

ggplot() +
  # Draw county boundary outlines
  geom_sf(data = fl_counties, fill = "#f5f5f5", color = "#d0d0d0", linewidth = 0.3) +
  # Add dots sized by total votes and colored by margin of victory
  geom_sf(
    data = fl_centroids,
    aes(size = total_votes, fill = margin),
    shape = 21,
    color = "white",
    stroke = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_size_area(
    name = "Total Votes",
    max_size = 13,
    labels = label_comma()
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    name = "Margin",
    low = "#2166ac",
    mid = "#f7f7f7",
    high = "#b2182b",
    midpoint = 0,
    labels = label_percent()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2022 Florida Governor Race (Proportional Bubble Map)",
    subtitle = "Dot size reflects total votes; color gradient indicates margin of victory",
    caption = "Source: Florida Department of State"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray30"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "gray50", hjust = 0.95),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal"
  )
```
